title: Delivery Receipt Checklist
subtitle: Carrier Delivery Receipt: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Delivery Receipt Checklist covers transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record. The delivery operations coordinator records Carrier Delivery Receipt criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Delivery Receipt Checklist keeps Carrier Delivery Receipt exceptions visible until the delivery operations coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Delivery Receipt Checklist at vehicle, consignee dock, delivery point, and return documentation route. Document transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record identity before Carrier Delivery Receipt begins. Compare transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record findings with stated Carrier Delivery Receipt criteria; route unresolved Carrier Delivery Receipt issues to carrier documentation reviewer.

sections.title: Inspector, location, and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Carrier Delivery Receipt, identify responsible parties, vehicle, consignee dock, delivery point, and return documentation route, and the linked transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record source.

fields.label: Carrier, driver, vehicle, trailer, and seal

sections.title: Observed conditions and item decisions
sections.guidance: Capture Carrier Delivery Receipt facts for transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Inspection disposition and reviewer acknowledgment
sections.guidance: Use observed Carrier Delivery Receipt evidence to state disposition. Keep limits visible and give Delivery Operations Coordinator both correction and repeat-check responsibility.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Count, seal, or freight condition exception
blocks.guidance: Pause Carrier Delivery Receipt when count, condition, recipient authority, exception notation, or document custody remains unresolved. Retain the available Carrier Delivery Receipt proof and route unresolved transport unit, freight pieces, delivery notation, consignee handoff, and carrier record scope to delivery operations coordinator.
